##### Project general facts

Vista Hub is a Grade A commercial building developed by Prestige One Developments in collaboration with Drake & Scull International. The project is planned for companies that want a corporate address with executive, business, wellness and leisure facilities in the same building. A contemporary tower rises above a landscaped podium, with a glazed facade, illuminated office floors and planted terraces. The building offers corporate offices, offices with private balconies and ground-floor retail shops, served by high-speed elevators, generous ceiling heights and dedicated podium parking levels, all held on a freehold basis.

The amenity programme is spread across the ground floor and the podium levels above it. The ground floor has a grand lobby, a water pavilion, an outdoor lounge, a garden lounge and a mini-golf course. For wellness, there is a fitness centre, an open-air fitness deck and a wellness area. Business spaces include a collaborative work lounge, a podcast studio, an executive gathering suite and an owners lounge. Leisure options cover table tennis, foosball, a grill pavilion, Ember Lounge, Aqua Vista, Flame Circle, Cascade Court, Olive Court and a perch wall, while the upper amenity level adds an open-air theatre, the Grand Pavilion and a relaxation lounge.

Interior renders show office spaces with timber wall panelling, built-in shelving, concealed warm lighting and full-height glazing that brings daylight and outward views into the work floors. Offices with balconies extend each workspace onto a private outdoor area with planting. The shared lounges use curved upholstered seating, timber pergolas and soft lighting, and the fitness centre combines a timber ceiling with a marked indoor sprint lane. Ground-floor retail units line the building frontage on either side of the grand lobby, with glazed shopfronts facing the street.

##### Location description and benefits

Majan is an urban district of Dubai with direct access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, set close to landscaped green spaces and established residential communities. Majan Public Park and Al Barari Park lie a short drive away, and Arabian Ranches, Dubai Silicon Oasis and Dubai Science Park are within easy reach. The same road corridor links the district with Downtown Dubai, Palm Jumeirah and Dubai International Airport, so the central business and tourism areas of the city stay within a practical drive.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road is the main transport route for the district and connects it with the wider Dubai road network. For everyday shopping and dining, City Land Mall is close by, while Dubai Hills Mall, The Dubai Mall and Mall of the Emirates serve larger retail trips. Leisure destinations nearby include Global Village and IMG Worlds of Adventure, together with the parks of Majan and Al Barari. Arabian Ranches and Dubai Silicon Oasis add established residential and business communities to the surrounding area.

Majan combines road access, nearby residential communities and a growing urban base, which gives the district appeal for businesses looking for a commercial address outside the central business districts. Grade A office space in this area suits owner-occupiers who want their own premises as well as investors targeting corporate tenants and service businesses. Ground-floor retail benefits from the daily population of offices and surrounding homes. Property in this part of Majan is sold on a freehold basis.
